repo_notes.content: CiviWave-FEM is a GPU-accelerated Finite Element Method (FEM) solver optimized for AMD integrated GPUs. Uses Vulkan 1.3 compute pipelines with Slang shaders, C++26/GCC 15.2, CMake 4.1.2. Source-first dependency policy via FetchContent. Key directories: src/ (core), include/cwf/ (headers), tests/ (Google Test), docs/ (guides). Physics: linear small-strain elasticity, implicit Newmark-β, matrix-free PCG solver. GPU kernels in Slang compiled to SPIR-V.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio

repo_notes.content: CiviWave-FEM é um solucionador MEF acelerado por GPU para iGPUs AMD. Usa Vulkan 1.3 compute com shaders Slang, C++26/GCC 15.2, CMake 4.1.2. Política source-first via FetchContent. Diretórios: src/ (core), include/cwf/ (headers), tests/ (Google Test), docs/ (guias). Física: elasticidade linear pequenas deformações, Newmark-β implícito, PCG matrix-free. Kernels GPU em Slang compilados para SPIR-V.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio

repo_notes.content: ARCHITECTURE: YAML config → Gmsh mesh loading → CPU preprocessing (gradients, volumes, mass) → GPU buffer upload (SoA) → Newmark-β time stepping → PCG solve → post-processing (von Mises, VTU export). GPU uses VK_EXT_descriptor_buffer, timeline semaphores, wave64 subgroups for AMD RDNA.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio

repo_notes.content: ARQUITETURA: Config YAML → carregamento Gmsh → pré-processamento CPU (gradientes, volumes, massa) → upload GPU (SoA) → Newmark-β → PCG → pós-processamento (von Mises, VTU). GPU usa VK_EXT_descriptor_buffer, semáforos timeline, subgrupos wave64 para AMD RDNA.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio

repo_notes.content: SHADERS: src/shaders/ - ke_apply_element.slang (strain→stress→forces), ke_gather_node.slang (nodal assembly), pcg_*.slang (CG solver), newmark_*.slang (time integration), derive_fields.slang (post-processing). Utilities: common.slang, reductions.slang, bc.slang.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio

repo_notes.content: PHYSICS: Linear elasticity ε=sym(∇u), σ=D:ε with 6×6 Voigt D-matrix. Rayleigh damping C=α·M+β·K. Newmark-β (β=0.25, γ=0.5), K_eff=K+(γ/βΔt)C+(1/βΔt²)M. PCG with block-Jacobi preconditioner, FP64 reductions, relative tolerance.
repo_notes.author: LukeFrankio

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: CiviWave-FEM introduction: GPU-accelerated FEM for structural dynamics on AMD iGPUs. Vulkan 1.3, Slang shaders, C++26/GCC 15.2. Matrix-free implicit solver, source-first dependencies, wave64 optimization.

pages.title: Getting Started

page_notes.content: Key files: docs/dev-setup-windows.md, docs/dev-setup-linux.md, docs/versions.yaml, CMakePresets.json, tests/data/cantilever.yaml

pages.title: Architecture
pages.purpose: System architecture: data flow YAML→mesh→GPU→post-processing. Major subsystems: config/, mesh/, gpu/, physics/, post/, ui/. Build system with CMake, FetchContent dependencies, SlangCompile.cmake.

page_notes.content: Key files: CMakeLists.txt, src/CMakeLists.txt, cmake/Modules/*.cmake, docs/dependencies.md

pages.title: GPU Compute Architecture
pages.purpose: Vulkan 1.3 compute: VulkanContext initialization (AMD iGPU preference), descriptor buffers, timeline semaphores, VMA allocator, staging ring. Wave64 subgroups, workgroup sizing for RDNA.

pages.title: Configuration System
pages.purpose: YAML configuration: schema reference (mesh, materials, assignments, damping, time, solver, loads, dirichlet, output). Material definition (E, ν, ρ), Lamé parameters, D-matrix. Loads (gravity, tractions, curves) and Dirichlet BCs.

page_notes.content: Key files: src/config/config.cpp, include/cwf/config/config.hpp, tests/data/*.yaml, include/cwf/physics/materials.hpp, include/cwf/physics/loads.hpp

pages.title: Mesh Processing
pages.purpose: Mesh pipeline: Gmsh 4.1 ASCII loading ($MeshFormat, $PhysicalNames, $Nodes, $Elements), element types (tet4, hex8). Preprocessing: validation, shape function gradients ∇N, volumes, lumped mass. SoA buffer packing for GPU upload.

page_notes.content: Key files: src/mesh/mesh.cpp, src/mesh/preprocess.cpp, include/cwf/mesh/*.hpp, src/gpu/buffers.cpp

pages.title: Shader System
pages.purpose: Slang shaders: compilation to SPIR-V via SlangCompile.cmake. Kernel organization: ke_apply_element (B^T D B u), ke_gather_node (scatter-add), pcg_* (CG stages), newmark_* (time integration), derive_fields. Utilities: common.slang, reductions.slang, bc.slang.

pages.title: Element Stiffness Kernels
pages.purpose: ke_apply_element.slang: compute strain ε=B·u, stress σ=D·ε, internal force f_int=B^T·σ. Linear small-strain formulation. ke_gather_node.slang: atomic scatter-add to global node vector.

pages.title: PCG Solver Kernels
pages.purpose: GPU PCG: pcg_precondition (block-Jacobi), pcg_dot_partials (FP64 sums), pcg_reduce_final (α, β), pcg_axpy (vector updates), pcg_enforce_dirichlet. Matrix-free K·x via element kernels.

pages.title: Time Integration Kernels
pages.purpose: Newmark-β GPU: newmark_predictor.slang (predict u,v,a), newmark_update.slang (correct after PCG). Implicit average acceleration (β=0.25, γ=0.5).

pages.title: Physics Solvers
pages.purpose: Implicit FEM: linear elasticity ε=½(∇u+∇u^T), σ=D:ε (Voigt). Newmark-β time integration (predictor-corrector). PCG solver with block-Jacobi preconditioner, FP64 reductions, relative tolerance ||r||<tol·||r₀||. Dirichlet BC enforcement, load assembly.

page_notes.content: Key files: src/physics/solver.cpp, src/physics/newmark.cpp, src/physics/loads.cpp, include/cwf/physics/*.hpp

pages.title: Post-Processing
pages.purpose: Derived fields: displacement magnitude, von Mises stress, principal stresses, strain energy. GPU kernel derive_fields.slang. VTU export for ParaView. Probe logging.

pages.title: Viewer
pages.purpose: Real-time viewer: VulkanViewer class with swapchain, graphics pipeline, ImGui integration. Controls: mesh settings, deformation, stress coloring, edge/vertex overlays. Hot-reload system: YAML scanning, reload_from_config(), camera fitting.

pages.title: Testing
pages.purpose: Google Test suite: unit tests (config_validation, mesh_loader, preprocess, pcg, newmark_stepper), validation tests (cantilever beam, block compression, plate bending vs analytical solutions). CTest integration.

page_notes.content: Key files: tests/CMakeLists.txt, tests/*_test.cpp, tests/data/*.yaml, docs/validation.md

pages.title: Contributing
pages.purpose: Contribution guidelines: C++26 style (clang-format, clang-tidy), PR process, testing requirements. Naming: snake_case functions, PascalCase types. Future roadmap: corotational formulation, adaptive time stepping, multi-GPU, plasticity.
